description: Authoritative UI display mode enums for Component C-11 and Interface I-16 as defined by Architecture Revision 3.

definitions.LIVE_ACTIVE: Real-time navigation actively publishing with nominal confidence.
definitions.LIVE_DEGRADED: Real-time navigation active under degraded integrity with uncertainty indicators displayed.
definitions.LIVE_BLACKOUT: Real-time GNSS blackout navigation; dead-reckoning tunnel display active.
definitions.REPLAY_ACTIVE: Historical session replay playing with prominent REPLAY badge.
definitions.REPLAY_PAUSED: Historical session replay paused at fixed epoch.
definitions.STALE: Output frozen or paused; last known position held with explicit STALE marker.
definitions.FAULT: Unrecoverable core or sensor failure; navigation UI displays failure state.
